_about: Minos River Island (levels 4-26): King Minos's court already stands in the island rooms by the Plains (zone 60) and keeps its helpers there; the Pit of Minos, now written, is where the bull-king himself waits on his throne of horns, a boss, his henchmen Franz and Hanz charging in as he weakens.
